name: Johnny Claes
features: dark hair, narrow intelligent face, thin moustache, slender build, musician\u2019s hands
bio: Founder of Ecurie Belge and a professional jazz trumpeter who led his own band, Johnny Claes and his Clay Pigeons. Ran a Talbot-Lago through the early championship years and won the 1953 Liege-Rome-Liege rally outright. Tuberculosis killed him at thirty-nine.
